turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My flatmates and I are at war over the dishes. The sink's been full for days.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yikes. Would a weekly dish rota help, or should everyone just have their own set of plates and wash them straight away?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, can you stay quiet for a minute? I need to talk to my partner. I'll come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Look at these leaves. Do you think something's eating them?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, those holes look like slugs to me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great. What do your parents use against slugs?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: My mom puts crushed eggshells around the plants. Dad just goes out at night with a torch and picks them off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm not doing the torch thing. Eggshells I can manage.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: We have loads, I made an omelette yesterday.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that took a while. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. So, the flat's dish problem. Which fix?
